_doc: ADDITIVE overlay for specimens/keynesian.json — web-grounded 2026-06-10. Never duplicates base data; all ids match the base specimen exactly. theory_dna shares are ESTIMATES (disclosed basis, conf<=0.6), conceptually the gain_v2 quantity — NOT measured bits.

now_extension.what: EU's reformed fiscal rules (revised Stability and Growth Pact) enter into force: debt-sustainability-anchored national net-expenditure paths replace one-size deficit targets; applied from 2025.

Argentina under Milei runs the live anti-Keynesian experiment: ~30% real spending cut ('chainsaw'), first sustained monthly fiscal surpluses in decades (primary surplus ~1.8% GDP), monthly inflation collapses from 25.5% (Dec 2023) — at the cost of recession and poverty spiking to ~53%. The austerity dark-cousin's strongest recent showing.

IMF Fiscal Monitor 'Putting a Lid on Public Debt': global public debt to exceed US$100tn (~93% of world GDP) in 2024 and keep rising — the post-COVID Keynesian expansions collide with debt-sustainability limits.

UK Budget: Chancellor Reeves rewrites the fiscal rules (debt measured as public-sector net financial liabilities) to unlock ~£70bn additional investment borrowing over five years — an investment-Keynesian turn inside a fiscal-discipline frame.

DOGE austerity experiment: largest peacetime federal workforce cut on record (~271k jobs, ~9% of federal workers) yet FY2025 spending RISES ~$301bn to >$7tn — entitlement-driven budgets defeat discretionary austerity; DOGE dissolved as a centralized entity by Nov 2025.

Germany amends the Basic Law (Bundestag 512-206; Bundesrat 21 Mar): debt-brake exemption for defense spending >1% GDP + a borrowing-financed €500bn/12-year infrastructure fund — the flagship austerity-era fiscal rule cracked open for state-led investment.

US One Big Beautiful Bill Act signed: CBO scores +$3.4tn deficits 2025-2034 (~$4.1tn with interest), the costliest reconciliation act on record — large deficits are now bipartisan PRACTICE but tax-cut-driven, not demand-management doctrine: deficit politics decouples from Keynesian theory.

The General Theory turns 90: commemorative workshops (YSI/INET 7th demand-led-growth workshop 'The General Theory at 90'; BSE Summer Forum) and press retrospectives — alongside simultaneous anti-Keynesian retrospectives (Cobden Centre/FFF 'The Damage Still Done... 90 Years On'). The weld is still actively contested at NOW.

act-revival-economists.born: Stiglitz 1943-02-09; Krugman 1953-02-28; DeLong 1960-06-24 (composite actor — all living as of 2026-06)

act-hm-treasury.founded: 12th c. (medieval Exchequer origins); permanent Treasury board 1714

child-keynesian-macro.named: 'Keynesian' current by late 1930s; 'macroeconomics' as a discipline-label 1940s (Klein's 'The Keynesian Revolution', 1947, fixes the canon name)

sub-says-law.named: 1921 — the TERM 'Say's Law' coined by Fred M. Taylor, 'Principles of Economics' (a century after the doctrine)

desc-postkeynesian.named: 1975 (Eichner-Kregel JEL survey formalizes 'post-Keynesian'); Journal of Post Keynesian Economics founded 1978

desc-newkeynesian.named: mid-1980s (label often attributed to Parkin); consolidated by Mankiw-Romer 'New Keynesian Economics' volumes 1991

action_spaces_unlocked[0].consolidated: 1946 (US Employment Act makes it standing doctrine)

cultural_harvest[0].emerged: 1942-1946 (Beveridge 1942; UK Employment White Paper 1944; US Employment Act 1946)

cultural_harvest[1].consolidated: recurrent — strongest waves 1980s and 2010-2015 (post-GFC European austerity); 2024-25 Milei/DOGE the latest (see now_extension)

cultural_harvest[3].consolidated: 2011 (sequel 'Fight of the Century'; tens of millions of views)

rel-monetarism.when: 1982-1992 (money-supply targeting abandoned after unstable velocity; the natural-rate core absorbed into inflation-targeting central banking)

rel-austrian.when: persists — heterodox since the 1940s; recurring popular/political revivals (2010s internet, 2023- Milei explicitly Austrian-adjacent)

rel-stockholm.when: 1940s-50s (dissolved into mainstream macro after WWII; no separate school persists)

rel-kaleckian.when: 1950s-present (lives on inside post-Keynesian economics, never mainstream)

rel-marginalist-revolution.when: ongoing — as the microfoundations apparatus (Walrasian GE -> new-classical -> DSGE), both substrate and besieger of the child

pf-classical.basis: ESTIMATE conf 0.5 — historiographic consensus that Keynes kept the Marshallian/marginalist toolkit: the apparatus survives as IS-LM's other curve and as the re-imported microfoundations (base survived[] ledger)

pf-underconsumption.basis: ESTIMATE conf 0.5 — the demand-deficiency INSIGHT is load-bearing but its machinery was discarded (insight kept, moralizing baggage dropped per base dropped[])

pf-wicksell-stockholm.basis: ESTIMATE conf 0.4 — corroborating independent content (natural-vs-market rate; ex-ante/ex-post) ran mostly parallel; lightly load-bearing in Keynes's own weld

pf-multiplier-liqpref.basis: ESTIMATE conf 0.5 — the welding operator BECAME durable core: multiplier + liquidity preference are the taught machinery (base survived[]: 'the welding operators... BECAME the durable core')

novel_residue.basis: ESTIMATE conf 0.5 — the synergy share: under-employment equilibrium, paradox of thrift, macroeconomics-as-a-level, state-as-residual-demand-maker (base surprise, surprise_confidence 0.9). Conceptually the gain_v2 quantity; rendered as a disclosed proxy, NEVER as measured bits — gain_v2 numbers do not exist for this specimen.
